2,669 likes, 73 comments - arihantbaidofficial on September 15, 2026: "This is real development! 

Walking around one of the wealthiest cities in the World in one of the richest country, I realised that in most of the main city, there were almost no private cars. The city center was full of trams and public buses while the cars had a very clear route which allowed them to keep the main town from getting swamped by traffic. 

This is Basel in Switzerland 🇨🇭".
